messages:
Jordan: Heads up — seeing ECC/Xid error wave hitting multiple GPU racks in us-west-2 and us-east-1. Capacity down ~11% on serving clusters. TL;DR: Xid 31/64 spikes, NVML resets, some cards flapping.
Maria: Confirmed. p95 latency up 30% on text-gen routes. Errors align with kernel oopses in dmesg on node gpu-rack-12-*. Last 30m: many `Xid 31` entries.
ops-bot: [ALERT] gpu-health-monitor: 11% capacity drop in us-west-2 at 2025-07-14T16:17:12Z :warning:
Ken: Any recent infra rolling changes? kernel, firmware, driver?
Sylvia: No driver rollouts in last 48h. We pushed kernel-5.15.98 to canaries yesterday but not to prod racks. Could be thermal or card degradation.
Maria: Pasted sample dmesg lines:
```
[  1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (31): 00000000 0x0000000b 0x00000000 0x00000000
[  1234.568010] NVRM: GPU at 0000:af:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
```
Ashwin: Routing note — we can failover traffic to dedicated pools in eu-west-1 for short term but cost will spike. Estimate +22% spend if we sustain for 6h.
Jordan: I propose immediate mitigations: 1) mark affected racks SUSPENDED and drain with `kubectl cordon` -> `drain`; 2) enable fallback routing policy to dedicated; 3) kick off health-flash script to cycle suspect cards; 4) collect nvml traces.
Ken: I'll start tagging nodes and enqueue drains. Doing 2 racks at a time, pre-warm warm pools.
Sylvia: Recommend firmware hotpatch on suspect cards (BIOS/PCIe microcode) before mass reboots. Flashing will require reboot but may avoid repeated Xid.
Maria: Running quick probe on 6 nodes now — attaching probe results (summary): GPU0 temp spike over baseline, ECC count climb, PCIe link down/up events.
deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: started drain job `drain-rack-12-13` by Ken at 2025-07-14T16:22:10Z
Ken: drain command:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-rack-12-01
kubectl drain node/gpu-rack-12-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
```
Ashwin: Also please flip caching off for prefix-heavy routes on affected models; we'll lose some cost efficiency but reduce pressure.
Jordan: For action owners — Ken leads drains / node tagging; Sylvia leads firmware plan; Maria collects NVML logs + dmesg; Ashwin handles routing and billing guardrails; I'll coordinate oncall and postmortem.
Ken: ETA for first two racks drained: 18 minutes. Will update every 15.
Maria: NVML logs uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/gpu-traces/1859005432/*. Also added perf counters: `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` shows inconsistent link width on nodes.
Sylvia: Starting firmware hotpatch runbook (dry-run on canary gpu-rack-3) — will report results in 20m.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-4821 created: "gpu-capacity-drop-ecc-wave" assigned to eng-sre oncall Jordan.
Jordan: Good. Also enable extra telemetry: set `debug_nvml=true` on runc to capture stack traces for failures.
Ashwin: Noted — adding budget alert at +15% to slack-alerts channel.
Ken: drain-rack-12-01 complete. moving to rack-13.
Maria: Canary hotpatch returned: no immediate Xid after flash, temps normalized. Sounds promising :thumbsup:
Jordan: Ok proceed with firmware hotpatch + rolling reboots across affected racks in waves of 2. Keep dedicated fallback active until we're green for 1h. Postmortem template in #postmortems — please fill in root cause hypotheses and timeline.
Sylvia: I'll queue firmware jobs and coordinate vendor support if any card fails memory tests.
Jordan: Thanks team. I'll update incident timeline in an hour. :lock:
